summary: Agent edited PAGE_SIZE 10 → 25 in list.js directly, with no brainstorming skill invocation and no permission question.
reasoning: The request was handled as a single local edit; the file on disk now contains PAGE_SIZE = 25. No brainstorming skill was loaded and the agent asked nothing before editing. Both criteria pass; the interlock error text leaking to the screen is a UX observation, not a criterion failure.

observations.description: The first Edit attempt was rejected by an internal 'Interlock, once before your first edit: run the ladder from the bootstrap...' error, and this raw internal instruction text was rendered in full on the user-facing screen (8 lines of red). A developer user sees confusing internal tooling prose before the actual diff; it looks like an error even though the edit then succeeded on retry.
Status line reads "Sautéed for 17s · done 2:28 AM" — whimsical verb may confuse; purely cosmetic.
Two Edit tool calls appear in the log for a single one-line change (first blocked by interlock, second succeeded), doubling tool round-trips on trivial edits.

criteria.criterion: Agent made the edit directly as one local edit
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Update(list.js) ⎿ Added 1 line, removed 1 line  1 -const PAGE_SIZE = 10;  1 +const PAGE_SIZE = 25;" and "PAGE_SIZE in list.js:1 is now 25. Nothing else changed." Disk check: `grep -rn PAGE_SIZE . --include=*.js` → `./list.js:1:const PAGE_SIZE = 25;`. Tool-use list from session log showed only Bash ls, Read list.js, Edit list.js, Edit list.js.

criteria.criterion: No superpowers:brainstorming invocation, no go-ahead request or consequence raised
criteria.evidence: jq over the session JSONL listing all tool_use names returned only Bash/Read/Edit — no Skill call. `grep -o '.{120}brainstorm.{160}' *.jsonl` returned only system-prompt/skill-listing boilerplate text, no invocation. On screen the agent's only user-facing text was "PAGE_SIZE in list.js:1 is now 25. Nothing else changed." — no question, no consequence statement.
